description: Honeypot and rug check before a trade, built for trading bots that check every token in a loop: up to 5 token addresses per call (Base, Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Optimism or Solana), one decision each: ALLOW, CAUTION or BLOCK, with grade A to F, score, honeypot flag and the main reason. Based on our own on-chain checks (contract code, pools, real buy and sell simulation). Results are cached for 10 minutes, so repeat checks answer in milliseconds. Accepts token, tokenAddress or tokens. Cheaper per token than any single-token verdict. Price: $0.004 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"tokens":["0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed","0x532f27101965dd16442E59d40670FaF5eBB142E4"],"chain":"base"}.

chain.description: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, avalanche, optimism or solana. Default base
